Subtract 307 days from 1985-02-01.  
1985 is not a leap year (1984 was leap).  
From 1985-02-01 back 31 days → 1985-01-01.  
Remaining 307 − 31 = 276 days to go back into 1984.  
1984 is leap year (366 days). 366 − 276 = 90 days left in 1984 after going back.  
90 days from end of 1984: Dec 31 − 90 days → 1984-10-02.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1984-10-02
